name: A Kiss At Midnight
source:
It's New Year's Eve, and college student Rachel is desperately waiting for her date to arrive as she anticipates the romantic kiss they will share as the new year begins.  Her roommate Becca keeps telling her not to worry.  Her roommate's boyfriend Garth assures her he'll be there soon.  Midnight is approaching so where is he?

[From [url=https://heavenshire-stories.itch.io/a-kiss-at-midnight]Itch.io[/url]]
